title: Report a problem
intro: This goes to the Ustaad.com team, not to any tutor. You do not need an account.

category.label: What kind of problem is it?
category.incorrect_ai_output: The AI gave a wrong answer

detail.label: What happened?
detail.hint: Write in English or Urdu — whichever you prefer. It is stored exactly as you write it.
detail.placeholder: The area filter was hard to find on my phone…

safety.label: This is a safety concern
safety.hint: Safety reports jump the queue and are never shown to the tutor concerned.

recorded: Your report has been recorded and is in the team’s queue. If you raised a safety concern, it is prioritised and is never shown to the tutor concerned.
anonymous: You do not need an account. An anonymous report carries no name, no email and nothing that could identify you.

rating.label: How is Ustaad.com working for you overall?

attachment.label: Attach a screenshot or document
attachment.hint: Optional. PNG, JPG or PDF, up to 5 MB. One file.
attachment.tooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB. Nothing has been uploaded.
attachment.wrongType: Only PNG, JPG or PDF can be attached. Nothing has been uploaded.

context.heading: Sent with your report
context.body: So the team can reproduce what you saw without having to ask you. Nothing here identifies you.

next.heading: Your report is recorded
next.body: It is in the team’s queue with a status of new, and somebody reads every one. You will not get a reply here — there is no address attached to an anonymous report — but the record is what gets acted on.
next.safety: You marked this a safety concern, so it is escalated in the queue. It is never shown publicly and never shown to any tutor in a form that identifies you.

detailTooShort: Please describe what happened — a sentence is enough.
